name: Better
tagline: Post a goal, let friends support it, and connect spending data to stay accountable.

awards: Build on the Knot TransactionLink API by Knot API

problem: Students want to achieve goals but lack motivation.
solution: An app and website for posting goals with community support and financial incentives linked through transaction APIs.
demo_moment: Team-described: create a goal and see friends back it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Build on the Knot TransactionLink API by Knot API” among 195 submissions.
Uses transaction data as an accountability signal.
